title: Square Root of the Learning Threshold
statement: Let $t$ be a positive rational number and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\le \tfrac12$. Set $e=\varepsilon/8$, $d=\lceil t/e\rceil$, and $\tau=(e^2/t^2)(1/9)^d$. Then $\sqrt{\tau}= (e/t)(1/3)^d$, with the quantities on both sides regarded as real numbers.
